name: Outer Gates
description: The Outer Gates serve as the fortified entrance to Ka Vethan. Void‑reinforced gateworks, Luclinite barrier pylons, patrol checkpoints, and resonance‑aligned portcullises regulate all ingress into the Akhevan capital. Military sentinels enforce Praesertum decrees, ensuring that only authorized individuals may pass into the Ascendant Causeway and deeper into the city.
